_about: Settings for per-lane speed and the fastest/slowest announcement (notes/lane_speed_plan.md).
Fixed and committed before any lane speed was computed. Changing them later is a documented amendment.
window_note: Set to 25 s by the project owner (was 60 s) so a 30 s clip gives rolling results. Validation numbers in notes/lane_speed.md section 4 were measured with 60 s windows.
_amendments: A2 (before any lane speed): ground point = the tracker's anchor (box bottom-centre) in the stabilised frame; the bottom + half-width shift below is not used (it misplaced vehicles in the ground-truth lane check). See notes/lane_speed_plan.md section 11.
A3 (before any lane speed): camera motion is removed (stabilize.py); lanes come from all analysis windows of a camera.
A4 (before any lane speed): a plausibility limit counts as exceeded only beyond 3x the step's own measurement noise.

A5 (POST HOC, after validating MiTra 0-120 s; confirmed on held-out 120-180 s): the stretch is the longest contiguous run of well-covered bins (a tree zone inside the stretch biased speeds by -10..-25%); the acceleration test's noise includes each track's slow speed wobble.

A6 (POST HOC, same procedure): plausibility cuts are off (plausibility.enabled = false). 535 of 535 remaining cuts were ordinary steps; with no cuts the median error was 3.4% vs 3.8-4.0%, precision 0.94 vs 0.88. Edie sums are invariant to identity breaks anyway. Chosen by a rule fixed before the comparison: lower median relative error, then precision.

A7 (28 Nov 2026, set before measuring lane-change accuracy, then REJECTED): lane changes need real sideways movement (lane_change block). On development 0-120 s it cut right-moving recall from 0.50 to 0.05 (redesign with the manoeuvre skipped: 0.25-0.30) without removing the jam's false changes, so lane_change.enabled = false. Held-out 120-180 s not used. Lane speeds unaffected.
_ground_point_note: 'box_centre' is a misnomer kept for compatibility: the point used is the tracker's anchor, x_px / y_px = bottom-centre of the box (see notes/lane_speed.md 1.3).

lane_change._note: A7 (rule set before measuring lane-change accuracy): a change counts only if the vehicle's position across the road moves by >= min_lateral_frac of the lane spacing (median over window_s before vs after the crossing, gap_s skipped either side). Targets: precision >= 0.8, recall >= 0.7 per direction. RESULT on development 0-120 s (right-moving): labels only P 0.77 R 0.50; A7 as set P 0.33 R 0.05; redesign with 1.5 s gaps P 0.63-0.67 R 0.25-0.30. It removes real changes and does not remove false ones, so it is REJECTED and disabled (enabled false). Held-out 120-180 s was not used for this decision. Lane changes stay label-based (0.5 s hysteresis, placed at the line crossing).

auxiliary_lane_rule: A lane is auxiliary (measured, not ranked) when it is listed in the camera config's lane_speed.auxiliary_lanes. For MiTra the list is filled from ground truth: our lanes whose boxes map mostly to GT lane 10 (the ramp lane).
